subject: Superintendent Performance Evaluation 2019–2020
overview: The committee reviewed and accepted the 2019–2020 performance evaluation for Superintendent Marice Edouard-Vincent, forwarding it to the regular School Committee meeting for final adoption. Members also referred the development of future evaluation procedures to subcommittee.

items.title: 2019–2020 Superintendent Performance Evaluation
items.summary: Accepted the 2019–2020 performance evaluation for Superintendent Dr. Marice Edouard-Vincent and voted to report it out to the regular School Committee meeting for official approval.

items.title: Evaluation Procedure Referral
items.summary: Referred the creation of a written, step-by-step superintendent evaluation timeline and process to the Rules, Policy, and Equity Subcommittee.
